caption: The drawing depicts a detailed design for a rickshaw or carriage in several views and details. At the top center, there is a colored side view of the entire vehicle, which has two large spoked wheels at the back and two smaller wheels at the front. The body of the carriage is dark green, with a high, curved canopy, and two long, slightly curved metal shafts extend forward for pulling. The seating area is lined in blue upholstery and has wooden armrests. Below the main image, on the left, is a technical line drawing with dimensions marked in black and red, showing the side profile and main measurements of the vehicle. In the middle center is a rear view of the open carriage, colored similarly in dark green with a painted floral detail on the lower panel. To the upper right, there is a small diagram of the profile of the seat and armrest. At the bottom right, there is a colored detail of the interior upholstery, which is tufted, light blue, and has buttons, with visible wooden arms and a floral carpet or mat at the base. The background of the drawing is a plain, cream color, and there are handwritten notations and a signature at the bottom left.
title: Baby Carriage
